body.x: Tag Corporation will showcase its Fishing TAG global service at CES 2019, the world's largest technology exhibition in Las Vegas, USA, from January 8, 2019 through January 11,

Founded in 2014, Tag Corporation focused on an intuitive interface based on creativity. Tag Corporation is a young company that grows through constant challenge by creating innovation based on strong teamwork.

The distinguishing features of the online mobile fishing tournament, GLOBAL FishingTAG Service, are as follows. ▲ Online fishing tournament that moved offline fishing tournament to mobile devices ▲ Fishing tournament where the world can participate without any limitation of time and space ▲ Automatic measuring system to provide accurate size and information of fish caught by user ▲ Possible to compete fairly Fishing Tournament ▲ Fishing Tournament to be enjoyed by all over the world with free participation in each country and region ▲ Participation by region and country using GPS and functions which makes it possible to share fishing hobby information through SNS.

Meanwhile, Daegu Technopark, which participates in the CES with local companies every year, will introduce 21 promising domestic companies in the upcoming 2019 CES. The 21 companies are available at the South Plaza Design & Source Showcase Zones in the showroom. Below are the companies that are participating in CES with support from Daegu Technopark Mobile Convergence Center. ▲Intin ▲RF ▲LILLYCOVER ▲JJTech ▲3i ▲Falcon ▲Green Zone Security ▲Tech Inc. ▲Netblue ▲COBL ▲Daeyoung Chaevi ▲Second Ground ▲iGiS ▲Namgyeong ▲Joy Drone. These companies will also participate in the “MIK Night” event, hosted by AVING NEWS.
